messages:
Emily (CS): Hey team — following up on last night's outage for hosted text-gen. A few customers have asked for a short RCA and a customer-facing message. Can we lock down a concise summary and an action list for follow-up?

Alex Li: +1. I can draft the technical RCA bullet points. Quick recap from infra: thundering herd on model X v2 caused CPU saturation in the routing layer which cascaded to request queuing and timeouts for ~27 minutes. We fell back to model X v1 automatically at 03:18 UTC.

oncall-bot: @here Paging alert acknowledged by Sandeep Rao at 2024-07-30 02:51 UTC. Incident ID: INC-20240730-87.

Maya Patel: For customers impacted, what was the customer-visible window? I have a list of accounts that ticketed.

Sandeep Rao: Customer-visible errors started at ~02:42 UTC (requests started timing out). Automatic fallback kicked in at 03:18 UTC, and error rates normalized by ~03:55 UTC after draining the backlog. So roughly 13:42 -> 03:55 UTC (sorry, that was a brainfart, meant 02:42 -> 03:55 UTC). Total ~73 minutes, but severe error spike was ~27 minutes (02:42-03:09) when routing layer saturated.

Emily (CS): Good note, Sandeep. Customers will want concise numbers: start time, duration, impact, affected endpoints, mitigation, and follow-ups. Also, any data exposure concerns?

Alex Li: No data exfiltration. This was a capacity/timeout problem only. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (hosted) for model X v2 and streaming sessions for a subset of requests. Embeddings unaffected.

Maya Patel: Draft customer message suggestion: "We experienced elevated error rates for text generation (model X v2) between 02:42–03:55 UTC on 2024-07-30. Impact: intermittent timeouts and failures for requests to /v1/generate. Root cause: routing layer CPU saturation under an unexpected request spike; automatic fallback to model X v1 restored service while we addressed the issue. No customer data was exposed." Thoughts?

Sandeep Rao: That reads well. Add a line about compensatory credits if customers were on paid reserved capacity? We typically offer 5% credit for >1hr major incidents unless otherwise negotiated.

Emily (CS): Add that as optional: "If you experienced sustained failures that impacted production, contact your CSM for support and potential service credits."

Alex Li: I'll add a short technical timeline for the internal RCA that we can attach if customers request more detail. Rough timeline: 
- 02:38 UTC: routing node CPU metrics spike begins.
- 02:42 UTC: client timeouts start to increase; error rate 9x baseline.
- 02:51 UTC: on-call page routed to Sandeep.
- 03:00 UTC: mitigation attempts: temporary routing throttles applied (didn't fully relieve backlog).
- 03:18 UTC: automatic fallback to model X v1 triggered by policy; successful.
- 03:30 UTC: additional capacity added to routing tier; queue drains.
- 03:55 UTC: error rates back to normal.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20240730-87 marked RESOLVED by Sandeep Rao at 2024-07-30 04:10 UTC. Postmortem requested: yes.

Maya Patel: For the status page update I'd propose: "Resolved — Intermittent errors for Hosted Text Generation (model X v2). Customers may have observed timeouts between 02:42–03:55 UTC UTC. Full service restored; no customer data exposed. A post-incident report will be published within 48 hours." Keep it short.

Emily (CS): OK let's standardize the customer-facing RCA format so CS teams can reuse it. Suggested template (short): 
Subject: Incident report — Hosted text generation errors (2024-07-30)
Body: 
- What happened: short one-liner.
- Impact: who/what endpoints and times.
- Root cause: one-liner.
- Mitigation: what we did and current status.
- Next steps: what we're doing to prevent recurrence and ETA.
- Contact: CSM email + support link.

Alex Li: I'll fill the technical "next steps" draft: 
- Improve routing autoscaling thresholds to detect CPU pressure earlier (ETA 2 weeks).
- Harden fallback policy to trigger earlier under high-queue scenarios (ETA 1 week).
- Add canary throttling for model rollouts to limit blast radius (ETA 3 weeks).
- Post-incident load test to validate changes (ETA 1 week).

Sandeep Rao: Action items for ops: 
- Add extra alert for routing CPU + queue growth (owner: Sandeep, due: 2024-08-02).
- Run tabletop for similar spike scenarios (owner: Maya, due: 2024-08-07).
- Confirm billing/credits policy with finance for incidents >60m (owner: Emily, due: 2024-08-05).

Maya Patel: I'll take the customer message and send to the impacted accounts with the template. Suggest we post a short status page entry now (resolved) and schedule a fuller postmortem link in 48h.

Emily (CS): Quick polish of the customer message: 
"Hello — we wanted to follow up about the incident on 2024-07-30 that affected hosted text-generation (model X v2). We observed elevated error rates and intermittent timeouts between 02:42–03:55 UTC. We automatically routed traffic to a compatible model (X v1) to restore service. No customer data was exposed.

We are taking the following steps to prevent recurrence: improve autoscaling thresholds, adjust fallback timing, and run targeted load tests. If you experienced production impact, please reply to this message or open a ticket; your CSM can discuss service credits where applicable.

We will publish a detailed post-incident report within 48 hours. Thank you for your patience."

Sandeep Rao: That looks good. One edit: change "routed traffic to a compatible model" -> "automatically fell back to a compatible model" (less ambiguous).

Emily (CS): Updated. Maya: can you send this and cc me + Alex?

Maya Patel: Will do in ~10m. Sending now to first batch of impacted accounts; I'll keep a list and link here.

Alex Li: For the postmortem I'll prepare a 1-page summary + detailed timeline and attach logs and graphs. ETA for publishable version: 2024-07-31 16:00 UTC (within 48h).

Emily (CS): Perf. I'll prepare a short customer-friendly PDF version to attach to outreach.

Sandeep Rao: Locking in owners: Alex (RCA doc), Maya (outreach & status page), Emily (customer-facing doc & credits policy liaison). I'll follow up on alerting changes and fallback tuning.

Emily (CS): Thanks everyone. Leaving the thread open for any edits before I send. Once sent, please drop a quick note here with sent recipients and any replies so we can track follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Sent to 12 impacted customers at 04:35 UTC. Thread for replies created and linked in our CRM.

Emily (CS): Reporting back: two customers replied asking for more details on timeline; I linked the postmortem draft (internal) and promised a public summary when vetted. I'll post the final public RCA link here when Alex publishes.

Alex Li: Postmortem draft pushed to the incident board: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20240730-87 (internal only). Will notify when public version is ready.

incident-bot: Postmortem assigned to Alex Li, due 2024-07-31 16:00 UTC.

Sandeep Rao: Closing note — no further action required from CS to escalate for credits until finance confirms threshold. Emily please ping me if any customer escalations appear.

Emily (CS): Will do. Thanks all.
